cases.name: Anita McDonald
cases.narrative: He bound her wrists, likely with zip ties, and strangled her with his hands, then he cleaned her up, removed the bindings and placed her in the sleeping position on the bed in her Comfort Suites motel room. "She was posed to look like she was sleeping," said detective David Stromeyer, the lead investigator on the case.
